The '''Alaspin system''' was a part of the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Alaspin casino]].<ref name="Sisar">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Alaspin [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-8.<ref name="TEA" />
